evidence_status: Exact conditional participation and cash-schedule analysis, not a measured market or financeable business.
opportunity: S3 scientific-model reuse qualification; source-bound qualification output for a specified new scientific request.
actual_costs: unknown: no dollar telemetry or complete research labor record
actual_buyer_values: unknown; no elicited willingness to pay or commitments
scope: At most three hypothetical participants, uniform per-mission prices, exact scenario tree and dated payments. Prices, costs and outside options in diagnostic grids are arbitrary supplied test conditions, not estimates of S3 demand.
stress_tree: success3/5; common technical failure1/5; withdrawal after core construction1/20; one failed adaptation1/20; one post-acceptance payer default1/20; one late refund/support1/20. These weights are supplied stress weights, not estimated probabilities. Common failure is shared, not diversified per buyer.
payment_timing: escrow day0; coordination/exploration day0; common construction day1; withdrawal day2; independently useful common acceptance day3; adaptations days4+i; mission acceptance days5+i; post-acceptance receipts plus declared delay; refund/support by day18; release support reserve day25.
cost_classification: A common construction required by the chosen joint contract exactly once, coordination, mission adaptation, support and route costs; B only extra retention/distribution; C only optional extra exploration. Unpaid earlier research is not booked as a paid contract or known zero cost.
factorial: Neither T nor D: conventional delivery for a singleton. T alone: common instrument but singleton commitment. D alone: coalition with conventional methods. Both: coalition and common instrument. Restricted factorial exposes mechanisms; unrestricted conventional entrepreneur gets every identical alternative and can tie or dominate.
participation: Risk-neutral expected customer value minus actual payment must exceed the supplied outside-option surplus. Withdrawal is allowed after sunk construction. No protected test or technical success is presumed by payment. Contract and rights eligibility remain explicit hypotheses.
objective: Within each restricted menu, enumerate every nonempty subset, every declared uniform price and each eligible payment mode; allow HOLD; maximize exact expected provider contribution subject to all supplied participation conditions and worst-prefix cash within declared cap for every named scenario. Ties use lower required opening cash, fewer participants and lexicographic plan identity.
liquidity: Refundable escrow is fully reserved liability. Only actual release following acceptance can reduce liability. Independently useful accepted common milestones may finance subsequent adaptation under explicit rights/use hypotheses. Support reserves and protected cash remain unavailable. No borrowing or token financing.

fresh_stress.policy: Freeze selected reference diagnostic plans before drawing a small synthetic stress sequence; report each failure, not retune. Test delays, common failure, withdrawal, partial acceptance, payer default and late refund combinations.

limits: No unrestricted contract design, heterogeneous price optimization, market equilibrium, empirical success probabilities, real commitments, live identities, learned financial benefit or production authority is established. Fresh synthetic cases test implementation under assumptions.
